text:
Nina (AE): Heads-up  client (Vertex Labs) paused PO until we deliver a clean DPA + order form. They also want BYOK HSM wording, SLA with 99.95% uptime, and split invoicing to UK/US entities. cc @Pri @Marta :wave;

Omar (SE): Do they want Dedicated or Hosted? BYOK details change accordingly.

Nina (AE): Dedicated in eu-west-1 for PHI workloads. Procurement says they will only countersign via their in-house e-sign tool SignSecure (not DocuSign).

Pri (Legal): Okay. Send their redlines. SignSecure will need legal review of the audit log and signer authority. Also note: they added an HSM attestation clause asking for annual SOC-type attestation.

Marta (Finance): For split invoicing we need both VAT IDs and billing addresses. They want GBP for UK ops and USD for US R&D. Net45 requested for UK leg; our default is net30.

Omar (SE): Technical: our HSM gateway supports PKCS#11 + AWS KMS + Azure Key Vault (wrapped). BYOK import process documented. I recommend adding a KMS appendix that says: "Customer retains sole control of key material; Redwood does not have access to plaintext key material; key usage metadata logged."

Pri (Legal): I'll soften "does not have access" and reference APP-KMS-2026-v2 for operational details. On the annual attestation ask, suggest we offer quarterly access logs + annual summary rather than a SOC report unless customer funds an SOC engagement.

Nina (AE): Procurement also asked to pin the model for first 90 days and require a 30-day rollback notice if we update.

Pri (Legal): Model-pinning clause: "Customer may request a Major.Minor model pin for up to 90 days; Redwood will not change pinned model without 30 days written notice, except for emergency security fixes." Adding that.

Marta (Finance): Billing note: we can accept SignSecure-signed PDFs if audit log meets policy and the signer is authorized. Need PO numbers to match invoices. For net45 exception I'll escalate to AR but need Legal signoff on countersign delegation.

esign-bot: Policy: external e-sign tools require (1) sample audit log, (2) signer identity proof, (3) proof of authority. See https://internal.redwood/esign-checklist

Pri (Legal): Action items:
- I'll produce a clean DPA + KMS appendix + order form with SLA language capped credits by EOD CET.
- I'll include an e-sign clause allowing SignSecure conditioned on audit log review.

Omar (SE): I'll attach the Dedicated deployment checklist and BYOK onboarding steps for their infra team.

Nina (AE): I'll ask Vertex procurement for the SignSecure sample audit log, both VAT IDs, billing addresses, and PO timing. I'll also confirm whether they want annual invoicing upfront or monthly.

Marta (Finance): If they request annual in advance we prefer annual prepaid for reserved capacity; AR can accept net45 on UK leg but will need procurement justification.

Pri (Legal): One more: they redlined liability cap tied to annual spend. They want unlimited for data breach. We'll push back and offer a capped carveout for gross negligence only.

Nina (AE): Summary / owners:
- Pri: DPA + order form + APP-KMS-2026-v2 reference + e-sign conditioned clause (EOD)
- Omar: deployment checklist + BYOK steps (today)
- Marta: billing template for split invoicing + net45 escalation path
- Nina: collect SignSecure audit log, VATs, PO estimate from Vertex

Marta (Finance): Please cc billing@redwood on the signed order. We'll only issue invoice once PO matched.

Nina (AE): Thanks team  will update thread when procurement responds. :white_check_mark:
